title: Workload profile
description: One named attention workload: a model's head geometry plus an explicit request schedule. The schedule is DATA, derived deterministically and hashed; it is never loop arithmetic inside benchmark code. Extending the lab to another model means adding a profile here, not editing a harness.

protected.description: True for a schedule that reproduces an accepted production run. A protected profile's parameters may only change through a reviewed change that names the reason and preserves the old record.

unresolved.description: Discrepancies that must be settled against the accepted application run before this profile may back a promotion. A non-empty list blocks `protected` status from being trusted.

resolved.description: Discrepancies that WERE listed in `unresolved` and have been settled, each entry recording the verdict, the evidence, and any residual check delegated to a gate. Append-only: a resolution is part of the profile's history, not clutter to delete.

layers.description: Number of layers running THIS attention operator. For a hybrid model this is the dense-attention layer count, not the total depth.

generator.description: Deterministic rule that expands `params` into the explicit case list. tools/gen_workload.py is the only sanctioned expander.

cases_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical expanded case list. Written into every result and manifest. Null only before first generation.

per_request.description: Operator invocations for one uncached request: chunks x layers. Asserted by the integration dispatch counters (Gate S0).

flops.description: Logically-attended-pair FLOPs. Masked rectangular attention makes this easy to misstate; a square-causal formula is always wrong here.
